verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly note you can 'Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments' and run the UI/pipelines entirely on your own machine with no account required, which supports isolated dev/test usage; dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage further support keeping test data separate from production data. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox mode' or documented workflow for testing against a non-production instance while cleanly switching to production. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented promotion path from sandbox to production, and independent confirmation that local/dev instances are fully isolated from production data stores.
